# Arrangements Log

> An iOS and iPadOS app for keeping your own dated, factual record of the calls and
> visits in a child contact arrangement — whether each one happened, how the actual
> times compared with the scheduled ones, and what occurred. Data stays on the
> device and in the user's own private iCloud; there are no accounts and no servers.

Made in the UK by Neutrade Ltd. Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad,
iOS 17 or later. Free for 14 days, then £4.99/month, or £49.99 once for lifetime
access. One purchase covers both iPhone and iPad.

Key facts, so they need not be inferred:

- The app is a personal record-keeping tool. It is **not** legal advice, and it is
  not a co-parenting or messaging app — nothing is shared with anyone, and the other
  parent has no visibility of any kind.
- There is no account to create and no sign-up. Sync between the user's own devices
  uses their private CloudKit database; the developer cannot read any of it.
- The user's record is never deleted for non-payment. If the subscription lapses or
  is cancelled, the record remains and stays exportable.
- Records export as JSON or CSV, and filtered views export as a dated PDF.
- Multiple children are supported, each with their own schedule and colour.
- Data collection as declared to Apple: **Data Not Collected**. No analytics, no
  advertising, no tracking, no third-party code. The only network traffic is Apple's
  own iCloud sync and the App Store purchase check.
- Two accurate qualifications, so summaries do not overstate the position: Apple may
  forward a crash report to the developer if the user has Apple's "Share With App
  Developers" setting on — those come from Apple, never from the app, and contain no
  part of the log. And the app touches the user's calendar only if they switch on
  "Show in my calendar", and then only to write the schedule events they asked for.

## Pages

- [Home](https://childarrangements.com/): what the app records, how the schedule and
  logging work, what the analysis reports, the three themes, pricing and FAQ.
- [Privacy Policy](https://childarrangements.com/privacy.html): what is stored, where
  it is stored, and what leaves the device (nothing, other than the user's own iCloud).
- [Support](https://childarrangements.com/support.html): common questions and how to
  get help.
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/arrangements-log/id6794839974):
  screenshots, current version and reviews.

## Common questions answered on the site

- Where is my data kept?
- Can the other parent see any of this?
- How do I get my data out?
- What happens if I cancel my subscription?
- Will it work if I move to a new iPhone?
- Can I record more than one child?
- Do you get crash reports?
